notablePrerequisites: You control an additional token copy of Sorcerer's Broom.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing one of your Sorcerer's Broom creatures, adding {C}{C}.
The surviving Sorcerer's Broom and Zulaport Cutthroat each trigger.
Resolve Zulaport Cutthroat's trigger, gaining 1 life and causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve Sorcerer's Broom's trigger, paying {3} to create a token copy of Sorcerer's Broom.
Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.
